source_acceptance.reason: P2627 supplies the missing tolerance formula, but the available micro coefficient remains target-dependent and broad. At most it supports a future approximate/interval bridge lane; it does not export the exact positive_beta_renormalization_source required by P2625.

tolerance_certificate.interpretation: The exact target Z_beta=100 has zero damping-denominator error by definition.  The QW-2064 micro median is close enough for a loose 15% finite-window denominator tolerance on d<=10, but neither the median nor the reported q25-q75 interval satisfies a strict 1% bridge tolerance, and the broad q25-q75 interval is far outside any narrow bridge envelope.

practical_epsilon_interval.proof: For the interval candidate D_Z(d)=1+(Z/100)d^(9/5) and strict denominator D_*(d)=1+d^(9/5), the relative error is |Z/100-1| d^(9/5)/(1+d^(9/5)).  On 0<d<=D this is maximized at D, so epsilon-admission requires |Z/100-1| <= epsilon*(1+D^(9/5))/D^(9/5).

strict_epsilon_interval.proof: For the interval candidate D_Z(d)=1+(Z/100)d^(9/5) and strict denominator D_*(d)=1+d^(9/5), the relative error is |Z/100-1| d^(9/5)/(1+d^(9/5)).  On 0<d<=D this is maximized at D, so epsilon-admission requires |Z/100-1| <= epsilon*(1+D^(9/5))/D^(9/5).
